entry.title: What context.Context is actually for
entry.summary: Why Go has context, how the cancellation tree works, every way to derive one (cancel, timeout, cause, value, WithoutCancel, AfterFunc), and the rules that keep it from leaking. With measured output.

entry.title: Go has no async/await. Here is what it has instead.
entry.summary: Where did await go? Goroutines park instead of blocking threads, the netpoller hides an event loop, and a handful of patterns replace promises. With runnable examples and measured output.

entry.title: How a request reaches a Kubernetes pod
entry.summary: Pod IPs, Services, kube-proxy, and where Ingress and Gateway API fit, including what changed in 2026: Ingress NGINX is retired and the IPVS backend is on its way out.

entry.title: What happens when you run kubectl apply
entry.summary: Follow one Deployment from kubectl apply to a running container: which component does each step, and where it breaks.

entry.title: Wrapping the tools you already have
entry.summary: How lazymobile follows an Android app across restarts, finds a release iOS app's output, and survives simctl formats that keep changing.

entry.title: What a goroutine actually is
entry.summary: Goroutines are not threads. How stacks, the G-M-P scheduler, blocking and preemption work, with a scheduler you can step through.

entry.title: Reading a MongoDB explain() in five minutes
entry.summary: Three numbers in explain('executionStats') tell you whether a MongoDB query is healthy, and one index rule fixes most slow ones.
